mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.parent_id,c.name,c.icon,c.ref_price_min,c.ref_price_max,c.region,c.level,c.sort_order, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(cc.country_code) FROM t_category_countries cc WHERE cc.category_id=c.id) AS country_codes FROM t_categories c WHERE c.active=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_category_countries cc WHERE cc.category_id=c.id AND cc.country_code=#{countryCode}) ORDER BY c.level ASC,c.sort_order ASC,c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id,p.category_id,p.name,p.spec,p.region,p.price,p.stock,p.image_urls, (SELECT s.id FROM t_store_products sp JOIN t_stores s ON s.id=sp.store_id WHERE sp.product_id=p.id AND s.owner_id=p.owner_id AND s.status='active') AS store_id FROM t_products p JOIN t_profiles seller ON seller.id=p.owner_id WHERE p.status='on' AND p.stock > 0 AND seller.carrier_verify_status='approved' AND seller.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_store_products sp JOIN t_stores st ON st.id=sp.store_id WHERE sp.product_id=p.id AND (st.owner_id<>p.owner_id OR st.status<>'active')) AND (seller.banned_until IS NULL OR seller.banned_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id,p.category_id,p.name,p.spec,p.region,p.price,p.stock,p.image_urls, (SELECT s.id FROM t_store_products sp JOIN t_stores s ON s.id=sp.store_id WHERE sp.product_id=p.id AND s.owner_id=p.owner_id AND s.status='active') AS store_id FROM t_products p JOIN t_profiles seller ON seller.id=p.owner_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.status='on' AND p.stock > 0 AND seller.carrier_verify_status='approved' AND seller.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_store_products sp JOIN t_stores st ON st.id=sp.store_id WHERE sp.product_id=p.id AND (st.owner_id<>p.owner_id OR st.status<>'active')) AND (seller.banned_until IS NULL OR seller.banned_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

SELECT id, CASE WHEN username REGEXP '@|^[+]?[0-9][- 0-9]{6,}$' THEN NULL ELSE username END AS username, nickname,avatar_url,city,carrier_verify_status,performance_score, star_avg,star_count,deal_count,ontime_count,user_role,buyer_verify_status, carrier_tier,invite_tier FROM t_profiles WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN #{id}
